newsitem.title: USA: Seaman agrees to buyout offer of $25.05/shr.
newsitem.headline: Seaman agrees to buyout offer of $25.05/shr.

text.p: Seaman Furniture Co Inc said Thursday it entered into a merger agreement with SFC Merger Co, owned by its majority stockholders, which provides for a cash consideration of $25.05 per share for each share of the company's outstanding stock.
Seaman said the investor group includes M.D. Sass Associates Inc, T. Rowe Price Recovery Fund LP and Carl Marks Management Co LP.
Under the terms of the merger agreement, the company will survive the merger and be owned by majority stockholders and the current senior managment.
The company said it expects a special meeting of stockholders for a vote on the merger in October.
